subject: The 2AM update you haven't seen
preview_text: Something changed in the app while you were away. A new feature that could save your next trade.
body_paragraphs: Remember those 2AM panic sells you swore you'd never make again? The ones where you watched the chart drop, your gut screamed SELL, and you hit the button just before a dead-cat bounce back up. I built this app to stop that.

Since you last opened Crypto AI, we added something that would have stopped you cold: a real-time 'Revenge Trade Detector' that pauses your order and shows you a 3-second replay of your last three trades. It's not a lecture. It's a mirror. And it's already cut emotional exits by 34% in our beta group.

Open the app and tap the new 'Coach' tab. Upload any chart screenshot—even one you just took from Twitter—and let Predictify walk you through the entry, stop, and target. No hype, no noise. Just a calm voice that says, 'Here's the data. Now decide.'

Go check it now. That screenshot you were about to trade on? Run it through the analyzer first. It takes 10 seconds.

P.S. Your free thesis from last week is still in the app—open it and see if the AI's confidence has shifted since then.
